controls.title: Secure development policy
controls.description: Establish and implement a policy to define security requirements for the development, acquisition, maintenance, and retirement of information systems and applications.

controls.title: Security requirements analysis and specification
controls.description: Define security requirements in the software development process based on business needs and the organization's security policy.

controls.title: Information and communication technology (ICT) supply chain security
controls.description: Manage and protect security aspects related to the risk of information and communication technology supply chain.

controls.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.description: Maintain separate development, test, and production environments to prevent unauthorized code or data exposure.

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: Implement and maintain procedures to control changes to information processing facilities and systems, including security impact assessment.

controls.title: Test information
controls.description: Select, protect, and control test information, ensuring that test data does not compromise security in production environments.

controls.title: Protection of information systems audit tools
controls.description: Protect information systems audit tools and security mechanisms from unauthorized access and misuse.

controls.title: Development of information security updates
controls.description: Establish procedures for the development and implementation of information security updates to maintain system security.

controls.title: Control of information processing facilities
controls.description: Implement controls over information processing facilities to ensure security and proper functioning of systems.
